assessments.reasoning: The registered README.md belongs to the exact z-lang/zc commit authored 26 December 2023. Its opening identifies a programming language designed for learning and sharing. The second cited span explicitly names the Gitee compiler repository, and the pinned tree places this README inside that same repository.

challenge.method: Verified the commit author date and README placement using the independently retrieved Git tree. Compared physical README lines 1–3 and 10 with the archived PLOC category and exact project URL. Compared the ISO catalog title as a shared-name control and checked the source context for evidence of an additional compiler repository.
challenge.results: The exact wording identifies one compiler repository. The README, project path, and PLOC listing agree about the claimed language referent. The ISO catalog describes a formal specification notation under a separate authority, so sharing the label Z provides no entity linkage.

limitations: Historical descriptive attribution at the pinned README. This supports neither compiler completeness, current development status, language relationships, nor compatibility with another use of the name Z.
